requirements.quote: components/drafting/{citation-panel,consistency-panel,ack-dialog,export-dialog}.tsx with stories and dialog interaction tests, wired into the studio from sub-issue 3.
Citation panel lists each citation with its verified, not found or unknown state and jumps to the span
a not-found citation blocks export until the ack dialog (tick 'I have verified these authorities myself' then Confirm) is confirmed and the acknowledgement is audited (acknowledgeUnverified).
Consistency panel groups findings by severity, 'Fix to graph value' is confirm-first, creates a new version (applyFix)
Undo is available for 7 days via the Activity Feed.
requirements.why: applyFix records only an audit entry, not an activity row with an undo window and a ProposalHandler undo (core automation: handlers/index.ts, undo.ts, possibly a schema kind). That is core work outside this web lane. This change ships an in-panel Undo that restores the pre-fix version as a new version; the Activity Feed 7-day registration is filed as a follow-up.

requirements.quote: Export dialog offers DOCX and PDF, shows the court preset and AI-assisted state, downloads via presigned URL (createDraftExportDownload); no send, share-by-email or file button.
Server actions in drafts/[id]/checks-actions.ts (run checks, acknowledge, fix, export) listed in cross-tenant-actions.test.ts.

deliverables.change: 'use server' file: runChecksAction, acknowledgeUnverifiedAction, applyFixAction (confirm z.literal(true)), exportDraftAction (exportDraft + enqueueDraftingExport), downloadDraftExportAction (createDraftExportDownload with objectStore()). Use workspaceAction/WorkspaceScoped and the rethrow mapping from actions.ts; async wrappers only exported.
Citation list using CitationStatus from @causedeck/ui, Check citations button, jump-to-span callback, not-found count opening ack dialog.
Findings grouped by severity, confirm-first Fix to graph value, in-panel Undo (restore previous version).
Dialog with checkbox 'I have verified these authorities myself' and Confirm disabled until ticked; calls acknowledge action.
DOCX/PDF choice, court preset and AI-assisted state, blocked while not-found citations are unacknowledged, download via presigned URL; no send/share/file control.
Stories for each component and state (fictional data).
Dialog interaction tests: Confirm disabled until ticked, ack calls action, export blocked until acknowledged, fix needs confirm step, no send/share/file button.
Add 'citations' and 'consistency' panels (lazy via dynamic, tabs, drawer/bottom sheet), Export entry, jump-to-span via existing finding navigation.
Load citation report (getCitationReport) and findings (listFindings) for the head version, pass checks actions and data to DraftStudio.
Add keys for severity groups, fix/undo/confirm, ack checkbox text, court preset, AI-assisted, download, errors.
Register the new keys' status as the existing stubs are.
Import checks-actions, add the five actions to ACTIONS with probe inputs, and add them to the own-workspace not-found test (pattern at the #827 test).

preserve.what: saveDraftAction and restoreDraftVersionAction behaviour and exports in apps/web/app/(app)/w/[slug]/drafts/[id]/actions.ts
Existing drafting i18n keys (acknowledgement.statement, export.*, panels.*) keep their names; only add keys. Core drafting exports in packages/core/src/drafting/index.ts unchanged.
Studio initial JS budget (180 KB gzip): new panels and dialogs stay lazy-loaded in studio.tsx

decisions.choice: In-lane Undo restores the pre-fix version via restoreVersion instead of an Activity Feed row
decisions.justification: applyFix writes only an audit record (packages/core/src/drafting/consistency-service.ts:~318) and the feed undo needs an activity row plus a ProposalHandler (packages/core/src/automation/undo.ts:170); that is core work, deferred as R5

decisions.choice: Do not run the cross-tenant action test locally; it needs a database and CI runs it
decisions.justification: CLAUDE.md lists registry tests as CI guards; the new actions are registered in D14

decisions.choice: Actions copy the workspaceAction + rethrow pattern
